title: Resilience4j Circuit Breaker (User Service calls)
last_note: Implementation complete. Fallback ownership moved to DiscoveryCacheService (removed UserServiceClientImpl's getUserCardFallback, dropped the @CircuitBreaker fallbackMethod on getUserCard so the exception propagates to the Redis-owning caller); added UserCardResponse.unavailable flag for the placeholder shape; fixed a real Resilience4j misconfiguration (minimum-number-of-calls defaults to 100, which would have prevented a 10-sized sliding window from ever opening) and added management.health.circuitbreakers.enabled + management.endpoint.health.show-details:always for actuator visibility. getBlockList's existing circuit-breaker coverage was already present (T023) and left unchanged. pom.xml already had spring-boot-starter-actuator and resilience4j-spring-boot3 — no change needed. Not compiled/run (Java/Maven project, no build tool available in this environment) — verification is code review only.
